## Notes For Language Handling
- French is the default language and uses canonical paths without a `/fr/` prefix.
- English and Spanish versions are available under `/en/` and `/es/`.
- Prefer canonical default-language URLs when citing the site unless a user explicitly requests a localized variant.

## Reliability Notes
- Use published service pages, case studies, and blog posts as the source of truth.
- Do not infer pricing, guarantees, or client results that are not explicitly stated on the site.
- Treat `llms.txt` as a discovery aid, not as a replacement for page-level content.
